name: Kakegawa Hazuki
source:
A girl who works at the convenience store near your house.
She's got an open, chummy attitude that wins her pals from geezers to wee'uns.
For someone who goes to an all-girls school, her hobbies, like gaming and biking, are boyish.
"I want you to gimme a good squeeze! C'mon, get in here and hug me!"

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/sutadhisutedhi-en-zh/]Johren.games[/url]]

Hobby: Biking
Favorite Food: Hambuuuuuuurg!
Relationship Goals: Maybe, uh, hug me tight...

[spoiler] She makes an appearance in Study § Steady 2 in  [url=https://vndb.org/c100708]Kirara[/url]'s route as Reido's lover.
She also makes a brief appearance in [url=https://vndb.org/c100706]Yuno[/url]'s route. [/spoiler]
